# Principle

Data communicated between different security domains for systems (infrastructure and applications) is controlled and subject to inspection and verification.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- No inbound content inspection is deployed.

Partially effective:
- Inbound inspection is deployed but does not cover all applicable content channels.
- Inspection is in place but detection signatures or rules are not maintained or updated.

Fully effective:
- Inbound content inspection covers all applicable content channels.
- Detection signatures and rules are maintained and updated on a regular cycle defined by the organisation.
- Blocked content is logged and available for review.
- Current cyber threat intelligence is considered when implementing controls to prevent the delivery of malicious or unsafe content.
title: Inspect inbound content from external or untrusted sources to prevent delivery of malicious or unsafe content.
